reference: R contdid 0.1.1 (cont_did; degree 3 without interior knots, and degree 2 with two) with not-yet-treated controls and a varying base period, the only settings contdid 0.1.1 applies (contdid issue #19), on a dose grid spanning every cell's doses (contdid issue #16). Point estimates are contdid's. Standard errors are sqrt(sum(IF^2))/n from the returned influence functions, after three one-line corrections listed in continuous_reference.R: the ACRT rescaling of contdid PR #17 (issue #13), the sign of the control part of the ATT(d) influence function in ptetools process_dose_gt, and R did's estimated-share term in ptetools pte_aggte. Unchanged contdid standard errors are kept as se_contdid. The level event study and the overall ATT's 'group' aggregation are from R did 2.5.1 (att_gt, not-yet-treated, varying).
